answer: Here an account is a promise of future work. The ledger tests that promise each epoch with a new ember and a jury of peers. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra comet buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the terrace behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal vfeut.
